title: solanum nigrum var. ochroleucum
intro: Solanum nigrum var. ochroleucum, commonly known as the yellow-blooming black nightshade, is a plant species belonging to the Solanaceae family. It is rich in health benefits, including its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and anti-cancer properties, making it a potential remedy for various diseases. The therapeutic actions of Solanum nigrum var. ochroleucum include its ability to inhibit the growth of cancer cells, reduce inflammation, and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include solanine, solamargine, and solasonine, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
